items.reason: In baskets the regimen is coded for the GBM arms (D31-C3); the GBM cohort 7 gives "BAY 3713372 alone", so no partner is given with the candidate there (D31-C2).

note: Both coders agree on MTAP-deletion eligibility matched to the PRMT5 inhibitor ("Homozygous MTAP-deletion identified through molecular testing", required of all participants including the GBM cohort, so D31-A1 does not apply; the record states the link: blocking PRMT5 "may kill the MTAP-deleted cancer cells"). Regimen monotherapy and no partners per D31-C3 (GBM window cohort 7 is monotherapy).

revisions.reason: The GBM arm is "A surgical window-of-opportunity trial of BAY 3713372 alone in participants with MTAP-deleted glioblastoma"; partners in NSCLC/PDAC cohorts are not given to GBM patients.
D31-C3 codes the regimen of the GBM arms in baskets, and Intervention Cohort 7 gives "BAY 3713372 alone".
